ga-county-commission-members.summary: The County card names the commissioners elected since November 2024 and lists the seats filled before then with no one in them. The map does not draw the districts commissioners are elected from.
ga-county-commission-members.why: No state office publishes who sits on Georgia's county commissions, so this app names them from the state's election results, which carry county races only from November 2024 on.
ga-county-commission-members.wanted: Each county's own list of its commissioners and the district each one represents, with its current district map.

ga-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Town card names the place and says when a city and its county are one government, and not who your mayor and council are.
ga-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of Georgia's mayors and council members has been read for this app, and no city's own pages have been read yet.
ga-municipal-officeholders.wanted: A statewide roster of every city's and town's mayor and council members by district, or each place's own published list.

ga-school-board-members.summary: A county school system's card names the board members elected since November 2024 and lists the seats filled before then with no one in them. City systems' boards are not named, and the map does not draw board districts.
ga-school-board-members.why: No statewide list of Georgia's school board members is published, so this app names county boards from the state's election results, which carry county races only from November 2024 on.
ga-school-board-members.wanted: Each school system's own list of its board members and the district each one represents, with its current district map.
